03   /   FIXTURES Examples and input contract

Input is an authored inert solid: stable fixture ID, parent ID and revision, depth and pitch in micrometres, and a starting index. Select or import on the rack; restart explicitly to discard the current teaching run. Each output record names its parent and ideal depth interval. The receipt is available after recovery.

04   /   EVIDENCE What the model represents
420 × 490 × 280 mmNominal external width × depth × height. Thermo catalogue, p. 43, specifies package 902100A; the real accessory set is not simulated.
64 mmNominal vertical carriage stroke, distinct from µm-scale pitch. The virtual linkage uses illustrative drop = 32(1 − cos θ) mm, not a measured cam. MICROM manual 387821, pp. 22, 25–26.
0.5–60 µmPublished scale range. The dotted turquoise datum is nonphysical. Listed UI values are teaching presets, not physical detents. The cyan key and transparent reference plane are authored geometry, not OEM controls. Source reports disagree on return retraction, so it is omitted.

One full virtual revolution records a complete interval only if it fits. Starting at index 7, depth 30 µm with pitch 10 µm yields centers 5, 15, 25 µm and no fourth record. The virtual count is not the mechanical counter. This is geometry and custody only: no blade or operational holder, material interaction, biological sample, calibration or real-world training.
